label: Updated 8 AM ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Poulter Knee Injury
items.text: Ian Poulter tore his meniscus hopping up two steps at a LIV Golf event and will have surgery in September, yet he continues competing while managing pain.

items.headline: Jaeger Withdraws With Back Injury
items.text: Stephan Jaeger withdrew mid-round from the Charles Schwab Challenge due to a back injury confirmed by PGA Tour Communications.

items.headline: 2026 Memorial Field Announced
items.text: Scottie Scheffler leads the field for the Memorial Tournament starting June 4, with Rory McIlroy and Jordan Spieth entered, while Viktor Hovland withdrew before the deadline.
